summary.text: Kristen Thompson is a Republican state senator from Oklahoma Senate District 22 who took office in November 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Kenny Kemper as her general-election opponent.

paragraphs.text: Thompson earned a B.S. in communications sciences and disorders from the University of Oklahoma.
Her career includes owning businesses in the construction and hospitality industries, and she has served on the Visit Edmond Tourism Advisory Board.
Thompson assumed office on November 23, 2022; the June 16, 2026 Republican primary for her seat was canceled.

For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists her as vice chair of the Business and Commerce Committee and a member of the Appropriations, Education and Senate Public Safety committees and the Joint Appropriations and Budget Committee.
